notes: Dataset includes consumable food items and prepared dishes only. Non-food materials, potion ingredients, seeds, fuel, healing supplies, and Seasoning are excluded.
BBQ Ribs is deduped across the Food and Thanksgiving Dinner tables into one row.
Carrot Cake healing has a source conflict: Items says +40 health; the Carrot Cake page says +10 health.
Event-linked Halloween and Thanksgiving foods are included as row-level availability caveats, not as a separate event catalog.
